integrity: The stability frontier is proved with the exact Jury conditions, and the rate optimum is proved by differentiating the dominant characteristic root. The bundled numerical/rational replay is supporting verification rather than a substitute for the quantified proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-dimensional deterministic fixed-step analysis for the symmetric split F(x)=a x and g(x)=mu x^2/2. It does not extend the source step-size guarantee to arbitrary nonlinear, nonnormal, constrained, multidimensional, adaptive, or stochastic problems.
title: Sharp scalar stability and rate-optimal splitting for averaged proximal reflected gradient
